description: This file defines the Customer entity class for the Shopizer e-commerce platform. It models customer data including personal details, relationships to other entities like reviews, groups, store, language, and embedded billing/delivery info, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer in the shop. It includes attributes such as id, email, gender, date of birth, associated reviews, store, language, billing and delivery info, and customer groups.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the customer's unique identifier.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the customer's unique identifier.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Returns a clone of the date of birth to prevent external modification.

methods.name: setDateOfBirth
methods.description: Sets the date of birth with a cloned value to avoid side-effects.

methods.name: getEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the customer's email address.

methods.name: setEmailAddress
methods.description: Sets the customer's email address.

methods.name: getNick
methods.description: Returns the customer's nickname.

methods.name: setNick
methods.description: Sets the customer's nickname.

methods.name: getCompany
methods.description: Returns the customer's company name.

methods.name: setCompany
methods.description: Sets the customer's company name.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the customer's password.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the customer's password.

methods.name: isAnonymous
methods.description: Returns whether the customer is anonymous.

methods.name: setAnonymous
methods.description: Sets the customer's anonymity status.

methods.name: getReviews
methods.description: Returns the list of product reviews made by the customer.

methods.name: setReviews
methods.description: Sets the list of product reviews.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates the customer with a merchant store.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves the merchant store associated with the customer.

methods.name: setDelivery
methods.description: Sets the delivery address details for the customer.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Gets the delivery address details.

methods.name: setBilling
methods.description: Sets the billing information for the customer.

methods.name: getBilling
methods.description: Retrieves the billing details.

methods.name: setGroups
methods.description: Assigns customer groups.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of groups the customer belongs to.

methods.name: getShowCustomerStateList
methods.description: Returns the UI state for customer state list display.

methods.name: setShowCustomerStateList
methods.description: Sets the UI state for customer state list display.

methods.name: getShowBillingStateList
methods.description: Returns the UI state for billing state list display.

methods.name: setShowBillingStateList
methods.description: Sets the UI state for billing state list display.

methods.name: getShowDeliveryStateList
methods.description: Returns the UI state for delivery state list display.

methods.name: setShowDeliveryStateList
methods.description: Sets the UI state for delivery state list display.

methods.name: getDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Returns the default language for the customer.

methods.name: setDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets the default language for the customer.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets customer attributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the set of customer attributes.

methods.name: setGender
methods.description: Sets the gender of the customer.

methods.name: getGender
methods.description: Returns the gender of the customer.
